items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single collectible/card illustration for Rift Hunters, a Japanese nocturnal fantasy pixel-art Godot game. Draw ONLY the specified central symbol/object, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background. Square 1024x1024 canvas, subject centered and contained within central 72 percent with generous transparent margins. Crisp hand-painted SNES-inspired pixel art, visible consistent pixel clusters, strong readable silhouette, limited deep indigo/violet/cyan palette, aged copper accents and warm amber lantern highlights, light from upper left, subtle violet rim lower right. One cohesive item icon, front or slight three-quarter view. Rich but legible at 128px. NO text, letters, readable glyphs, numbers, frame, badge, UI, floor, scene, watermark or checkerboard. No blurry airbrush, vector-flat graphics, photorealism or glossy 3D. Keep glow tight and alpha clean. Subject: three broken violet rift crystals arranged as a small pile, blue cores and copper-orange highlights.
